med.name: Recovery Link
med.desc: Heals and cures the user and nearby allies. Revives allies in range. Automatically triggers on lethal damage when not in a group.

tech.name: Tactical Link
tech.desc: Weapon enhancement system which provides temporarily increased damage and weapon performance to the user and all nearby allies

def.name: Survivor Link
def.desc: Increases damage resistance and speed for group members. Grants an emergency health boost to group members when taking lethal damage.
